why_it_moved.text: Overall Successful Search Rate is flat (+0.08%) because gains in Tail Queries (+3.40%) are offset by drops in Head Queries (-0.53%) and Navigational (-1.07%) queries; no cut has been run to confirm this.
why_it_moved.label: inferred

why_it_moved.text: Mobile looks worse than desktop (Successful Search Rate -0.73% vs -0.17%), so the Tail gain may come with a Mobile or Navigational cost.
why_it_moved.label: guess

why_it_moved.text: Queries per User (-0.66%) and Clicks per User (-0.51%) drifted down with no clear success gain, so users are not obviously finishing faster.
why_it_moved.label: guess

would_change: A pre-exposure comparison of Successful Search Rate showing the arms were level before the test would clear the one check that could not run.
A Tail Queries cut with matching arm counts would make this a targeted follow-up test on that segment.
